summary: Tooling is fully green (PHPStan level 9, ECS, lint twig/container/yaml, FR/EN translations in parity, strict_types everywhere), but 15 methods exceed 30 lines (-15 per rubric), mostly in demo fixtures and CSV import code. Two classes exceed 200 lines and the front-end code is minimal with no real dead code.

tool_outputs.phpstan: level 9 (bin, config, public, src, tests): [OK] No errors
tool_outputs.lint_twig: [OK] All 33 Twig files contain valid syntax.
tool_outputs.lint_container: [OK] The container was linted successfully: all services are injected with values that are compatible with their type declarations.
tool_outputs.lint_yaml: [OK] All 71 YAML files contain valid syntax.

findings.title: PHPStan level 9 with 0 errors
findings.detail: Max level configured and clean on bin, config, public, src, tests.

findings.title: ECS, Twig, container and YAML lint all pass
findings.detail: 0 error, 0 warning across 109 PHP files, 33 Twig templates, 71 YAML files.

findings.title: createOrUpdateVariant is 74 lines (cc~17); the class is 294 lines
findings.detail: Same file also has importProduct (l.111, 55 lines, cc~9), assignAttributes (l.257, 35 lines) and a 24-line constructor. The class exceeds 200 lines and mixes CSV orchestration, product, variant and attribute persistence.
findings.recommendation: Extract ProductUpserter, VariantUpserter and AttributeAssigner. Use guard clauses to bring cc under 10.

findings.title: buildForm is 62 lines
findings.detail: The poReference and costCenter fields and the event listener (l.75, 23 lines) are built inline in a single method.
findings.recommendation: Split into addPoReferenceField(), addCostCenterField() and a dedicated event subscriber. This is production code, not fixtures.

findings.title: parseHandle is 52 lines with cc~13
findings.detail: Header parsing, row validation and mapping happen in one loop.

findings.title: Fixture load() methods over 30 lines
findings.detail: PunchoutDemoFixture::load 55 lines, TierPricingDemoFixture::load (l.65) 50 lines cc 11, TradeCreditDemoFixture::load (l.66) 40 lines cc 10, QuoteDemoFixture::load (l.44) 39 lines cc 13, GpsrDemoFixture::load (l.53) 37 lines, TaxonDemoFixture::buildTree (l.70) 42 lines.
findings.recommendation: Extract one private method per entity created. Low priority because this is demo data, but it still counts in the scoring.

findings.title: Command is 201 lines; execute is 33 lines and runSubCommand is 39 lines
findings.detail: The class is slightly over the 200-line limit. runSubCommand (l.160) is 39 lines.
findings.recommendation: Extract the step list into a small DemoResetStep VO/collection and the sub-command runner into a service.

findings.title: addBuyerReference is 34 lines; findPoReference is 23 lines
findings.detail: XML DOM manipulation is concentrated in a few long methods.
findings.recommendation: Extract the XPath and node-creation helpers.

findings.title: plugin() is 32 lines with cc~11
findings.detail: Likely a match/switch over plugins, which is a data table disguised as code.
findings.recommendation: Replace it with a static array or a list of readonly DTOs.

findings.title: onOrderCompleted is 26 lines with cc~9
findings.detail: Close to the limit. Other 21-28 line methods: PurchaseApprovalDemoFixture::applyLimit (l.72), ProductAttributeDemoFixture::createOrUpdateAttribute (l.68), GpsrDemoFixture::findOrCreateManufacturer (l.97) and findOrCreateResponsiblePerson (l.122, near-duplicates), CustomerDemoFixture::createCustomer (l.56) and CompanyDemoFixture::createCustomer (l.88).
findings.recommendation: The two GpsrDemoFixture find-or-create methods and the two createCustomer methods are DRY candidates (a shared FindOrCreate helper or trait, per the rule of 3).

findings.title: Strict typing, no debug leftovers, no TODO/FIXME
findings.detail: All 109 PHP files declare strict_types=1. No var_dump, dd, TODO or FIXME found. The grep hits on 'dump(' were only false positives such as getFlashBag()->add.

findings.title: Non-final classes are limited to Doctrine/Sylius entities
findings.detail: Entities extending Sylius models (ShopUser, AdminUser, Taxon, TaxRate, etc.) are non-final, which is required for Doctrine proxies and Sylius resource overriding.
findings.recommendation: Consider final and readonly on the remaining services and DTOs only. Entities are fine.

findings.title: FR/EN translations are in parity
findings.detail: messages 63/63 keys, validators 4/4, legal 21/21. No missing keys in either direction.

findings.title: Front-end is minimal: no custom Stimulus controllers; the b2b SCSS entry is wired separately
findings.detail: assets/{shop,admin}/controllers/ contain only .gitignore. The bootstrap.js files are standard Symfony stimulus-bridge boilerplate with a commented-out example registration. b2b.scss (142 lines) is loaded through webpack.config.mjs:30 (addStyleEntry), not from entrypoint.js. The task brief mentioned 4 JS controllers, but only 4 boilerplate JS files exist (entrypoint and bootstrap for shop and admin) and there are no real controllers. _variables.scss (7 lines) is small.
findings.recommendation: Remove the commented example in bootstrap.js. Check that _variables.scss is imported by b2b.scss; otherwise it is dead. Document that the front end is Twig/theme only.
